inclusion_rule: Studies in the wiki that identify the user (subject identification, biometric authentication) from scalp EEG; the design compared is identification from speech-imagery trials and how identification is tested (session-held-out vs trials permuted across sessions). Boundary: identification used only as a nuisance factor is excluded; versions count once; the target is counted in the pattern match.
